Tethera 0.7.1 is a polish release: no new features, and the existing ones read more cleanly and behave more consistently.

Update with Tethera → Check for Updates…, `brew upgrade --cask tethera`, or `curl -fsSL https://tsogbat.github.io/tethera/install.sh | bash`. Your sessions keep running.

### App
- The sidebar's second line says what the agent is doing ("needs permission", "waiting"); the glyph already shows which agent, so nothing gets cut off anymore.
- A session that needs you is marked by its dot and its bold name only (the side bar is gone).
- Every pane header is the same height, so split panes line up.
- Home's Agents list uses drawn markers, and Ollama's menu a proper chevron.
- The status bar counts a waiting permission request once, under Approvals, not twice.
- In the approval inbox, ⌘↩ allows only the oldest request.
- Homebrew shows a loading state while it's being asked, and **Upgrade All** sits in the header instead of the bottom of a long list.
- Git's commit buttons are off when there's nothing to commit.

### Website
- Section labels and numbers above the headings are gone; the headings speak for themselves.
- Monospace is kept for code and keys; labels and captions use the text face.
- Dim text meets contrast guidelines in light and dark.
- The command examples wrap their comments on phones instead of running off the edge.
- Every screenshot is in the page itself, not only added by JavaScript.
